title: Mara and the River-Heart
moral: True courage means caring for others and not giving up.

scenes.summary: Mara begins her mission to find the River-Heart.
scenes.text: Mara sets out to recover a missing sacred stone believed to restore her village’s water.
scenes.image_prompt: girl explorer with headlamp and backpack preparing to enter cave

scenes.summary: She meets Kito and enters dangerous caves.
scenes.text: Mara teams up with Kito and they descend into deep caves following clues left behind.
scenes.image_prompt: two explorers descending into dark cave with ropes and headlamps

scenes.text: They cross rivers, narrow tunnels, and follow chalk markings deeper underground.
scenes.image_prompt: explorers crossing underground river with glowing cave walls

scenes.summary: Kito becomes weak and they must decide.
scenes.text: Kito falls ill, forcing Mara to balance the mission with caring for her partner.
scenes.image_prompt: girl helping tired friend inside cave with concern

scenes.text: Mara chooses wisely, continuing carefully while ensuring safety, proving true courage.
scenes.image_prompt: explorers moving forward carefully in cave with hope

story: Mara searches for a lost sacred stone in dangerous caves to restore her village’s water. Alongside Kito, she faces physical challenges and difficult decisions. Her journey shows that courage includes caring for others and acting responsibly.
